source_relation.attested: Arrival, continued residence and completed assimilation are distinct events.

chey.meaning: Strictly before completion of the supplied event; cessation at that event.

sorain.meaning: Completion of assimilation of the explicitly bound nutrient.

orar.meaning: Arrival/presentation of that nutrient to its explicitly bound recipient.

new_grammar: chey consumes exactly the next event expression; physical line break is allowed inside the same S paragraph.
TemporalGuard must attach to an explicitly written process/assertion; it is not a free sentence filler.
design.two_input_consequence: A process guarded by the first may continue after arrival but must end at assimilation; a process guarded by the second must cease earlier. One operator yields different temporal obligations.
design.serious_rival: chey means AFTER the event, reversing the permitted interval while preserving the two event denotations.
design.falsifier: Fail if either whole-clause attachment demands activity on the wrong side of its boundary, or a same written event is replaced by an unrelated occasion to avoid the conflict.
design.hard_countercase: Neither guarded process is decoded yet. S.17's remaining oldar ain and all S.12 preceding groups must be bound, and source event ordering cannot create target clause attachment.
design.freedom: 3 whole-form meanings,1 prefix guard production,2 explicit event references; subject/nutrient bindings unresolved and must be counted in a descendant.
